title: Create the Horizon acquisition accretion model
prompt:
Create this file:
`Deliverables/Horizon acquisition accretion dilution model - 7.4.xlsx`

Build the Horizon acquisition accretion and dilution model for the next investment-committee review.

Use the July corporate-development correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only and follow the controller's warning on seller adjustments, revenue synergies, and timing assumptions. Horizon is an external target, so keep the analysis tied to the controlling transaction sources rather than Alder Ridge's posted ledger.

Create `Buyer Standalone`, `Target Standalone`, `Sources & Uses`, `Purchase Accounting`, `Combined`, `Accretion Dilution`, and `Checks`. Model the financing mix, incremental interest and foregone cash yield, seller share issuance, purchase-accounting amortization, phased cost synergies, tax effects, and one-time integration costs. Show year-one and year-two GAAP and adjusted EPS accretion or dilution, with the financing, balance, EPS, and source controls needed for committee review.

Document the controlling sources in the workbook, recalculate the finished file, and save it to the exact target path.
